Question Choices: A shelf has 14 books. You take away 6 to read. How many are still on the shelf?
Solution: Take away four books to reach ten, then two more: 14 - 4 = 10 and 10 - 2 = 8 books left on the shelf.

Question Choices: Select. Does this statement correct? 19 - 10 + 3  = 4 + 7 ~~Yes | No~~
Solution: The left side is 19 - 10 = 9, then 9 + 3 = 12. The right side is 4 + 7 = 11. They are unequal, so No.

Question Choices: You have 2 full ten frames of stickers. Your teacher gives you 1 more sticker. How many stickers do you have now?
Solution: Two full frames hold 10 + 10 = 20 stickers. One more gives 20 + 1 = 21 stickers.

Question Choices: Mia had 20 grapes. She gave away 4 to her friend and got 2 more. How many grapes does Mia have now?
Hints: give away  = subtract "-", get more = add "+"| 20 - 4 + 2 = __
Solution: First give away four: 20 - 4 = 16. Then get two: 16 + 2 = 18 grapes.
